description:

title: DevOps Enginer
Engineering Manager -Backend
description:
About Meesho 
 
Mission and Vision 
 
Meesho is India’s fastest-growing internet commerce company, driven by the mission to democratize internet commerce for everyone (DICE). Our vision is to enable 100 million small businesses and entrepreneurs in India to succeed online, making online commerce accessible to all. This core purpose guides us in empowering sellers across the country and bringing a diverse range of products to first-time internet shoppers. By leveraging technology and a unique zero commission model, Meesho has opened the doors of e-commerce to millions who were previously underserved. 
 
Technological Scale & Innovation
 
 At Meesho, technology is at the heart of our success. We have invested in a scalable infrastructure and innovative solutions to meet the demands of a vast user base and complex marketplace. Some key highlights include: 
 
Massive Scale: Our backend systems handle millions of orders per day from across India, reaching about 5% of all Indian households, all with near-zero downtime to date. Achieving this level of reliability and performance in a hyper-growth environment is a testament to our engineering excellence. 
 
 Marketplace Reach: Over 1.75 million sellers are registered on Meesho’s platform, supported by our state-of-the-art tech infrastructure and pan-India logistics network. This wide reach — covering virtually every serviceable pin code in the country — presents unique engineering challenges in areas like search, personalization, and payments at scale.
 
 Scalable Architecture: We continually innovate our architecture for growth.. Our quest to serve a billion Indian users has helped us evolve our technologies from a monolith to microservices to now a high scale federated architecture. This evolution allows us to build and deploy features rapidly while maintaining stability for a fast-growing user base. 
 
Cutting-edge Tech Stack: Our platform is built using modern, open-source technologies on the cloud while ensuring high efficiency. We strategically choose proven tools (for example, Java and Golang for services, Kafka for messaging, Dragonfly and Redis for caching, ScyllaDB, MySQL and Mongo for Data) and leverage GCP infrastructure to ensure high performance, reliability, and flexibility. By focusing on the right tools for the right problems, we innovate pragmatically rather than chasing every new tech hype, which helps us solve real-world problems effectively. 
 
Engineering Culture & Challenges 
 
Engineering at Meesho is driven by a bold and inclusive culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe that building great products goes hand-in-hand with building a great team. Key aspects of our engineering culture include: 
 
Long Term Thinking: We believe in thinking for tomorrow while building for today, this approach has helped us not only to handle and evolve for scale but also focus on extensibility and stability by investing in the platform
 
Lightspeed: We prioritize rapid iteration and delivery. Engineers are encouraged to ship fast and refine continuously, as we value in order to learn and adapt quickly. 
 
Continuous Improvement: We view failures and bugs as opportunities to improve. A blameless post-mortem culture ensures that mistakes become lessons, fostering an environment where learning from failure drives resilience and innovation.
 
 Ownership Mindset: Every engineer is empowered to act like an owner. We instill a “Founder’s Mindset,” encouraging engineers to take end-to-end ownership of projects and drive them with an entrepreneurial spirit. This means our teams proactively identify problems and champion solutions, just as a founder would for their own product. 
 
Engineering at Meesho is more than just writing code – it's about solving complex, impactful problems at an unprecedented scale. Our engineers tackle challenging use cases (from enabling real-time logistics across India to optimizing a vast product catalog for the next billion users), making a tangible impact on millions of entrepreneurs and customers. We maintain a
professional, yet passionate work environment where the drive to innovate is balanced with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. 
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for Engineering Manager well-versed with emerging technologies to join our team.
 As an Engineering Manager, you will ensure consistency and quality by shaping the right strategies. You will keep an eye on all engineering projects and ensure all duties are fulfilled . You will analyse other employees’ tasks and carry on collaborations effectively. You will also transform newbies into experts and build reports on the progress of all projects.

title: Data Strategy Operations Manager
description:
About the Role

As the Data Strategy and Operations Manager at Abnormal AI, you will own our go-to-market data quality strategy and serve as the steward of data across Salesforce and the systems around it. You will design the processes, controls, and intelligent workflows that keep data accurate, enriched, and trusted at scale, so Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance can give executive leadership reliable metrics. You will decide where AI agents and automation take over repetitive data work and where human judgment still matters, and partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate system changes that affect our data programs.

Who you are

  • Data obsessed and just as obsessed with removing manual work, with a habit of automating any process that relies on fixing records by hand
  • Curious about AI and a daily user, with experience shipping workflows with LLMs, agents, or AI-assisted tooling, and able to tell a useful application from a demo
  • Eager to build and shape a program rather than only maintain one, and able to create systems that hold up at global scale
  • Highly analytical, able to see the big picture and spot trends and gaps, then zoom in with practical, specific recommendations
  • Steady when juggling multiple priorities in a constantly changing environment
  • A good teammate, dedicated to the mission, who likes to have fun along the way

What you will do

  • Set the data governance strategy, standards, ownership model, and source-of-truth hierarchy for GTM data across Salesforce and connected systems
  • Establish policies, access controls, and field-level definitions, including record creation and deprecation rules, and monitor adherence
  • Ensure compliance and security of our data, and flag risks to IT, security, and leadership
  • Replace high-volume manual tasks (deduplication, enrichment, account matching, hierarchy mapping, routing, anomaly review) with automated and AI-assisted workflows
  • Design and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered workflows that classify, enrich, validate, and remediate data, with guardrails, human review points, and accuracy measurement
  • Build automated data quality monitoring that detects issues early, alerts the right owner, and fixes them without human intervention where appropriate
  • Evaluate and select AI, enrichment, and automation tooling, run pilots, and measure impact through time saved, accuracy gains, and coverage
  • Own the enrichment strategy and keep account firmographics accurate: hierarchies, employee count, location, industry, and Fortune ranking
  • Act as the subject matter expert for Business Ops, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and Finance, run a defined feedback intake process, and support consistent reporting and dashboards
  • Manage a portfolio of data quality and automation projects with clear priorities, owners, and outcomes

Must Haves

  • 5+ years in Sales Operations, Data Operations, or a similar analytical or systems role
  • Hands-on experience building automation with AI or LLM tools (agents, prompt-driven workflows, AI-assisted enrichment), with shipped examples you can easily share
  • Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, data modeling, master data management, and requirements gathering
  • Demonstrated understanding of Salesforce automation, including Flow and validation rules, and experience working closely with admins
  • Experience implementing and managing data and enrichment tools, including AI-native tools such as Clay, Kernel, Starbridge, and Onfire
  • Proficiency in Excel
  • Track record of leading data management projects from idea to result
  • Sound judgment about where AI is reliable and where it needs controls for privacy, security, and accuracy
  • Detail oriented, self-motivated, proactive, and quick to learn new tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical and AI concepts to non-technical partners
  • Preferred: experience with workflow automation or integration platforms (such as Workato or Zapier), modern data stack tools (such as Snowflake or dbt), SQL, and a high-growth SaaS or security company

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

title: Sr Sales Ops Analyst
description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

The Senior Sales Operations Analyst is a high-visibility individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Sales Operations. You will own the analytic backbone of our GTM motion: building the models, reports, and processes that sales leadership relies on to call the business, allocate resources, and drive execution across seven global theatres. Your work will span pipeline analytics and conversion trends, revenue planning and capacity modeling, and quota and territory design. What Youâll Bring

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills â comfortable taking ambiguous requests from Sales, Marketing, and RevOps stakeholders, translating them into delivered analysis, and framing technical work as business impact for executive audiences.

  • Comfort working with large datasets in Databricks, Snowflake, or similar platforms beyond basic Excel and BI tool work.

title: Engineer Software Defined Vehicle Simulation and Development
description:
NIKI is looking for graduates of Technical University Departments/Schools of Sciences/Engineers, or similar disciplines to support and develop complex system simulation processes of software-defined vehicles.

Become a member of NIKI Digital Engineering!

If you have completed your studies or doctorate and are looking for new challenges, interdisciplinary and diverse teams, and projects, send us your resume.

Our strategy is to transfer the know-how into practice. TWT is our trusted long-term partner, sharing and supporting our vision. Through close, daily collaboration, we design and deliver innovative solutions for clients and partners across the energy, health, and automotive industries. Combining interdisciplinary expertise in IT, digital engineering, and consulting, we turn ideas into impactful results that reflect our shared vision for progress.

What to expect

  • Develop and optimize process and simulation methods for complex vehicle development in collaboration with international industry partners and research organizations.
  • Continuously monitor industry trends and advances in simulation technology to improve NIKI's services and drive innovation.
  • Coordinate our interdisciplinary projects in close cooperation with our customers.

Task Description

  • Modeling and simulation of complex systems and software functions. Focus on areas such as driving dynamics and autonomous driving.
  • Active cooperation with our customers. Programming of functions and algorithms for modern vehicle functions. Accompanying the process from the first idea to delivery.
  • Forward-looking development processes. Functional and vehicle development using the latest methods and tools, such as graphic modeling languages.
  • Empowering and coaching our clients.
  • Protection of software functions. Efficient implementation of technical security measures and criticality analysis of software functions.
  • Creation of test concepts. Development of automated test cases according to existing customer requirements. Test execution on the test bench or in road tests hedging concepts.
  • Development of new concepts for safeguarding networked systems (MIL/SIL/HIL) and also autonomous driving functions.
  • Development, commissioning, and testing of complex, multifunctional test benches.
  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality technical solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Knowledge of modeling and numerical simulation of mechanical systems.
  • Familiarization with the application of simulation or design software tools.
  • Good knowledge of at least one of the languages: Python, Matlab or Java.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Spirit of innovation, initiative, and enjoyment of learning and tinkering.
  • Excellent command of English and technical terminology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the automotive industry, with a focus on vehicle development and simulation.
  • Initial knowledge of semi-formal modeling languages such as UML, SysML or Matlab/Simulink or initial experience in handling measurement technology or test benches, such as Vector, dSPACE, ETAS, or initial experience with control units and software in the embedded area.
  • Interest in interdisciplinary collaborations.
  • Good command of the German language.

What we offer

  • Structured learning on the job, professional feedback, and a mentor open to all your questions.
  • Innovative, highly technically demanding industry and research projects, interdisciplinary teams, and highly qualified colleagues.
  • Open doors, and the chance to take over responsibility quickly - participate, shape, and leave your fingerprint.
  • Discover new talents and shape your career path: Become a specialist, project manager, or manager.
  • Simultaneous, collaborative work using modern digital platforms.
  • Workplace flexibility.
  • Flexible working hours thanks to our attractive flextime model - only compatible projects.
  • Enjoy working with great colleagues in your day-to-day work.

Are you intrigued to find out more about this position? Then apply for a job with us!
